correctness.rationale: On normalized Bergman monomial bases for -1<alpha<0, beta>alpha+2, the differential Hilbert coefficient B_ij=(i+1)/(i+j+1) sqrt(w_i(beta)/w_j(alpha)) has strictly positive Cauchy exterior minors. Dividing the kth compound by product of first k target row weights leaves row factors q_I decreasing and log convex, and positivity of maximizing vectors yields strict norm decrease; Holder gives log convexity. Fixed compact compound operator plus strong convergence of diagonal row weights to the first-row projection yields operator-norm convergence, whose selected exterior row norm equals k! sqrt(det G_k(alpha)) by Cauchy–Binet and the binomial moment kernel. Positive definite G and w_m(beta)~m! beta^{-m} imply the sharp fixed-k s_k~k sqrt((k-1)!) sqrt(det G_k/det G_{k-1}) beta^{-(k-1)/2}. At alpha=-1/2, k=1 constant 2sqrt(log 2). Independent finite-section SVD verified decreasing first three normalized singular-value products across beta=3,8,20,80; finite truncation not asserted to certify the limiting constants.
